title: Spring-Loaded Support Wheel for Gates – Stops Dragging in Gravel
descriptionHtml:
The gate has started to sag – and now it hits the ground

First it was just a squeak. Then it caught at one corner, and now you have to lift it every time you drive out. Gravel, frost heave and the gravel that has settled in the track make it bind exactly where you need it most, and the hinges are pulled crooked by the weight.

The wheel carries the weight – the spring takes the bumps

The support wheel is bolted to the underside of the gate and takes over the weight that would otherwise hang on the hinges. The spring keeps the wheel pressing against the ground the whole way but still lets it lift over a stone or an ice ridge, instead of digging into it. The gate moves easily again, and the post stops being pulled crooked.

Features

  • The gate stops hanging on the hinges – the wheel carries the weight, up to 600 lbs (272 kg)
  • Rolls over stones and ice ridges instead of binding – spring suspension that gives way upward
  • Follows the gate as it swings – 360° swivel wheel, not a fixed one that cuts into the gravel
  • Gets around on gravel and grass – 8-inch wheel with a heavy-duty rubber tire that doesn't sink in
  • Bolts onto your existing gate – mounting plate, U-bolts and wrench included

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
